title: The $5,000 Childcare Benefit 60% of Parents Miss
hook: Open enrollment is happening right now, and the most valuable benefit in your packet might be one you've never clicked on — worth up to $5,000 tax-free.
angle: During open enrollment season, parents have a closing window to claim a $5,000 Dependent Care FSA that cuts their childcare bill by up to $2,250 — and 60% of eligible workers never click on it.
audience: Parents with children under 13 paying for daycare, after-school care, preschool, or summer camps
key_numbers: $5,000 annual Dependent Care FSA contribution limit
Up to $2,250 in tax savings per year depending on bracket
$16,000 average annual childcare cost in the US
